title: Maintenance blocking rule is activated during scheduled maintenance
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Blocking Rule
  Scenario: Rule blocks operations during maintenance window
    Given a maintenance window is scheduled from 2024-01-15 10:00 to 2024-01-15 12:00
    When the current time is within the maintenance window
    Then the maintenance blocking rule should be active
    And all restricted operations should be blocked
rationale: Verifies that the maintenance blocking rule activates correctly during the scheduled maintenance period, which is the core functionality of the requirement.
generationSummary: Maintenance blocking rule - A system feature that prevents certain operations or actions during maintenance periods. Test cases cover rule activation, blocking behavior, exception handling, and maintenance window management.

title: Maintenance blocking rule is deactivated outside maintenance window
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Blocking Rule
  Scenario: Rule allows operations outside maintenance window
    Given a maintenance window is scheduled from 2024-01-15 10:00 to 2024-01-15 12:00
    When the current time is outside the maintenance window
    Then the maintenance blocking rule should be inactive
    And all operations should be allowed
rationale: Ensures that the blocking rule does not interfere with normal operations when maintenance is not scheduled, confirming proper rule deactivation.
generationSummary: Maintenance blocking rule - A system feature that prevents certain operations or actions during maintenance periods. Test cases cover rule activation, blocking behavior, exception handling, and maintenance window management.

title: User receives notification when attempting blocked operation during maintenance
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Blocking Rule
  Scenario: User is notified of blocked operation
    Given a maintenance window is active
    When a user attempts to perform a restricted operation
    Then the operation should be blocked
    And the user should receive a notification explaining the maintenance block
rationale: Validates that users are informed when their operations are blocked due to maintenance, improving user experience and transparency.

title: Multiple operations are blocked simultaneously during maintenance
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Blocking Rule
  Scenario: Multiple operations blocked during maintenance
    Given a maintenance window is active
    When multiple users attempt different restricted operations simultaneously
    Then all operations should be blocked
    And each user should receive appropriate blocking notifications
rationale: Ensures the blocking rule scales correctly and handles concurrent operation attempts during maintenance without allowing any to proceed.

title: Maintenance blocking rule respects exception list
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Blocking Rule
  Scenario: Whitelisted operations proceed during maintenance
    Given a maintenance window is active
    And certain operations are whitelisted as exceptions
    When a whitelisted operation is attempted
    Then the operation should be allowed to proceed
    And non-whitelisted operations should still be blocked
rationale: Verifies that critical or administrative operations can be exempted from the blocking rule when necessary, allowing essential maintenance tasks to continue.

title: Maintenance blocking rule can be manually activated
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Blocking Rule
  Scenario: Administrator manually activates blocking rule
    Given the maintenance blocking rule is configured
    When an administrator manually activates the rule
    Then the rule should become active immediately
    And all restricted operations should be blocked
rationale: Confirms that administrators can manually trigger the blocking rule outside of scheduled maintenance windows for emergency situations.

title: Maintenance blocking rule can be manually deactivated
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Blocking Rule
  Scenario: Administrator manually deactivates blocking rule
    Given the maintenance blocking rule is currently active
    When an administrator manually deactivates the rule
    Then the rule should become inactive immediately
    And all operations should be allowed to proceed
rationale: Ensures administrators can end the blocking rule early if maintenance completes ahead of schedule or in case of emergency.

    Given a maintenance window is active
    When operations are blocked by the maintenance rule
    Then each blocked operation should be logged with timestamp
    And the log should include operation type and user information

    When users access the system before the maintenance window
    Then a countdown timer should be displayed
    And the timer should show remaining time until maintenance begins

    Given a maintenance window is active
    When a user attempts to create, update, or delete data
    Then the modification should be blocked
    And the system should preserve data integrity
